claim_scope: Row23 authority/input request and plan-repair packet only. This packet prepares the missing-input request needed before any Row23 heldout/same-scenario semantic-quality work can continue safely.
evidence_scope: Targeted reads of allowed Row23 packets/status updates
Targeted reads of product-readiness-scenario-board.md, product-readiness-action-plan.md, and phase-14-user-visible-status-dashboard.md
No semantic-quality evaluation, heldout execution, host UI automation, training, source edit, or git action was performed

requested_input_or_approval.request: Provide a pre-existing or separately approved Row23 Codex heldout input, with source/provenance and explicit approval for Row23 semantic-quality evaluation.

Or provide explicit current approval to create a non-heldout runner-contract fixture only. This supports runner-contract/readback smoke only and must not be used as heldout/eval data or semantic-quality proof.

Provide accepted same-scenario Row23 before/after criteria if a semantic-quality claim is desired, including exact prompt/task, baseline/candidate comparison, scoring/rubric, leakage controls, and acceptance threshold before execution.

Provide an accepted host-visible evidence path if product/host readiness is desired, including exact Codex host surface, auth/session preflight, safe input/control path, screenshots/logs to capture, and no-secrets handling.

Or provide a different exact safe Row23 evidence path that explicitly preserves no training, no hidden/external AI, no product/source edits, no checkpoint/locator mutation, no product readiness claim, and no formal joined pass unless independently proven.

safe_options: Option A, requested/not_proven: Luba or parent supplies an existing approved Row23 Codex heldout input and accepted same-scenario before/after criteria.
Option B, requested/not_proven: Luba explicitly approves creation of a non-heldout runner-contract fixture only.
Option C, requested/not_proven: Luba or parent supplies an accepted host-visible evidence path for the same Row23 scenario.
Option D, requested/not_proven: Luba authorizes a different exact safe path with written scope, forbidden actions, claim locks, and review gate before execution.
forbidden_options: Do not create heldout/eval data without explicit current authority.
Do not treat a runner-contract fixture as heldout data.
Do not run semantic-quality evaluation from this packet.
Do not run heldout/same-scenario execution from this packet.

Do not run training, eval generation, DPO generation, checkpoint mutation, locator mutation, host UI automation, hidden/external AI, adapter/core invocation, product/core/plugin source edits, tests/builds, or git actions from this packet.
Do not advance to Row24 as if Row23 passed.

Do not claim semantic quality improvement, host readiness, product readiness, full Codex readiness, learnability, token savings, checkpoint promotion, locator update, full extension readiness, or formal joined pass from this packet.

Row23 remains open with semantic_quality_status=blocked_not_proven, product_readiness_claim=false, formal_joined_pass=false, and product_ready_extension_count=0.
